column1: # The data build of the 30B filtered arm (canary OR `mini >= 2`; the split names say only
# `mini_2plus`, and the `docs` column still holds the withdrawn mini-only revision's counts until
# dataset-builder's canary-inclusive rebuild lands), one line per corpus, consumed by
# configs/control_pretraining/build_corpora.sh. Column semantics are documented in the
# - Every subset is the `_filtered_mini_2plus` split, and `docs` is that split's RETAINED
#   document count from `filter_stats_mini_2plus` — the tokenize job's provenance
#   `num_documents` must equal it (verify_corpora.py checks exactly that).
# - ClimbMix is source-SLICED, not split: eight prepares of contiguous index ranges straight
#   into the shard roots, each tokenized as soon as its own prepare lands. This is how the
#   baseline's ClimbMix actually shipped (its README, "The shipped ClimbMix was built by
#   source-slicing"): no 1.7 TB JSONL, no separate split job, eight ~1 h steps instead of one
#   7.5 h one. `slice` needs the exact retained count, which is why `docs` is load-bearing.
# - The stage-3 SFT mix is a `pack` row: prepare (JSONL only) -> 16-way byte-gated split ->
#   one pack job per shard, with the training config reading the shard parquets by glob.
# Walltimes are the baseline's: every filtered corpus is at most its baseline size.
